# Japanese deinflection rules

`deinflect.json` is from FooSoft/Yomichan, commit
`2f13cf5d2ad33a627152457a3f120deb76739f60`:
https://github.com/FooSoft/yomichan/blob/2f13cf5d2ad33a627152457a3f120deb76739f60/ext/data/deinflect.json

Copyright the Yomichan authors; GPL-3.0, the same license as this project
(see the repository's LICENSE). `tools/gen_deinflect.py` generates
`core/deinflect.inc`. Both the source data and generated table are committed
so building the plugin does not require network access or Node.
